figures.label: Fig 2
figures.caption:
Example partial tree from the DT model showing the causal patterns for medication errors.
In this tree, if the decision is false (i.e., not a voided order), take the right branch; similarly, if the decision is true (i.e., voided order), take the left branch. Red and green boxes highlight the positive rates of greater than and less than 5% respectively. Note that this is a small portion of the total tree.
